title: Mayer-Vietoris sequences are compatible with pullback
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $X=U\cup V$ a union of two open subschemes, and $U'=g^{-1}(U)$, $V'=g^{-1}(V)$, so $Y=U'\cup V'$ and $U'\cap V'=g^{-1}(U\cap V)$; for $W\in\{U,V,U\cap V\}$ write $W'=g^{-1}(W)$ and $g_W:W'\to W$ for the restriction of $g$. Let $\mathcal G$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then the pullback maps of [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], $g^*:H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal G)\to H^q(Y_{\Et},g^{-1}\mathcal G)$ and $g_W^*:H^q(W_{\Et},\mathcal G|_W)\to H^q(W'_{\Et},g_W^{-1}(\mathcal G|_W))\cong H^q(W'_{\Et},(g^{-1}\mathcal G)|_{W'})$ (the identification being $H^q$ of the isomorphism $g_W^{-1}j_W^{-1}\cong j_{W'}^{-1}g^{-1}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition], both sides being inverse images along $g\circ j_{W'}=j_W\circ g_W$), form a morphism from the Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-mayer-vietoris] for $(X,U,V,\mathcal G)$ to the one for $(Y,U',V',g^{-1}\mathcal G)$: every square, including those with the connecting maps $\delta$, commutes.

source.place: Lemma Tag 0A50 (lemma-mayer-vietoris) and its proof (the short exact sequences $0\to\mathcal I^\bullet(X)\to\mathcal I^\bullet(U)\oplus\mathcal I^\bullet(V)\to\mathcal I^\bullet(U\cap V)\to0$ of an injective resolution); the compatibility with pullback is not stated in the source (agent-identified gap: it is needed for the reduction of Theorem 09YQ to the affine case)
